resources.string: Safely refreshes a stuck decision session for one zone or all zones
Selected zones: %1$s\n\nWatering history, learned results, and safety cooldowns are preserved. Only temporary decision state is cleared; pumps and valves are not activated.
The processes cannot be restarted while one of the selected zones is being watered.

Watering history, learned results, and the safety cooldown are preserved. Only the temporary measurement window, cycle lock, and pending prediction validation are cleared. The pump and valves are not activated.
There is no active zone that can be restarted.
The assistant process cannot be restarted while watering is active.
Restart request sent. Fresh, safe measurements will be collected for this zone.

First check that sensors provide current and correct readings, and verify moisture limits and pump durations. This clears temporary decision windows and cycle locks for every zone while preserving watering history, learned durations, and safety cooldowns. Pumps and valves are not activated immediately.
All processes cannot be restarted while a zone is being watered.
Restart request sent for all zones. The system will reassess fresh sensor readings.
The restart request could not be sent. Check the connection and try again.
